Entries.Original: I'm already sick of hearing that. Cut it out already.
But it's all the rage in Ruka Land. Who am I supposed to share the joy with, if not you?!
No one, that's who. Stop trying to make it happen.
Whaaat.
My god, stop saying that!
Why?
Didn't I say to stop trying to make it a thing?! So, stop!!!
But if I don't whoopsie gravy every once in a while, my head's going to explode from stress! Like, literally KABOOM!
That's not going to happen! That's NEVER going to happen!
Whyyy not?!
C'mon, I'm begging you! Just let me say it!
I'll only use it sometimes, I swear! It'll be as rare as a unicorn!
Ugh, fine...only sometimes, you got that?
Yukkie!
You've earned all my love and devotion just now.
Don't go around handing out your love and devotion for something as stupid as this...
Also, didn't I say you can only use it sometimes?
Yeah, this is that sometime. It's been a while since I said it, so my head was just about to explode. What a relief!
Just let that head of yours explode, if you're so bent on that!!!
Why are you so angry all of a sudden?! Please, go back to the normal Yukkie I know and love!
My "normal" is me being constantly annoyed and angry with you.
No way?! In that case, are you usually more lovey-dovey-Yukkie, or angry-Yukkie?!
Angry. I've never been lovey-dovey.
But what about that passionate night we spent together?!

Don't go around
making up weird stuff on your own!!
Stop it right now before I get seriously angry!!
Uwh...sniff...
What? Do you think that if you cry, I'll let you whoopsie gravy yourself out of this?
No, it's not about the gravy anymore...I just don't want you to hate me, Yukkie...that's all.
Ugh...look, I don't hate you or anything...
Seriously?!
Why are you so happy about that...?
Because I love you sooo much, Yukkie!
God, you're like a little kid...
Whatever. Fine. I'll let it go for today.
Really? You're gonna let me whoopsie? You're gonna let me gravy?! Alright, whoopsie gravy!
ARE YOU A DUM-DUM?!
Thank you, commander.
You're welcome. Now, let's begin.
